days_off_note.name: days_off_note
days_off_note.value: "days_off"."note" is null or char_length("days_off"."note") between 1 and 200

task_types_sp_default.name: task_types_sp_default
task_types_sp_default.value:
("task_types"."story_points_requirement" <> 'hidden' or "task_types"."default_story_points" is null)
        and ("task_types"."story_points_requirement" <> 'required' or "task_types"."default_story_points" is not null)

time_entries_limits.name: time_entries_limits
time_entries_limits.value:
char_length("time_entries"."title") between 1 and 200
        and ("time_entries"."link" is null or char_length("time_entries"."link") <= 2048)
        and ("time_entries"."note" is null or char_length("time_entries"."note") <= 2000)
        and "time_entries"."duration_minutes" between 0 and 1440

time_entries_overtime.name: time_entries_overtime
time_entries_overtime.value:
("time_entries"."overtime_minutes" is null and "time_entries"."overtime_note" is null)
        or ("time_entries"."overtime_minutes" between 1 and "time_entries"."duration_minutes"
          and not "time_entries"."running"
          and char_length("time_entries"."overtime_note") between 1 and 1000)

time_entries_extension.name: time_entries_extension
time_entries_extension.value:
("time_entries"."extension_minutes" is null and "time_entries"."extension_note" is null)
        or ("time_entries"."extension_minutes" between 1 and "time_entries"."duration_minutes"
          and not "time_entries"."running"
          and char_length("time_entries"."extension_note") between 1 and 1000)
